SELECT PCM.* FROM PARTY_ROLE PR INNER JOIN PARTY_CONTACT_MECH PCM ON PCM.PARTY_ID = PR.PARTY_ID AND
INNER JOIN CONTACT_MECH CM ON CM.CONTACT_MECH_ID = PCM.CONTACT_MECH_ID INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ROLE WETR ON WETR.ROLE_TYPE_ID = PR.ROLE_TYPE_ID WHERE WETR.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = #{workEffortTypeId} AND CM.CONTACT_MECH_TYPE_ID = 'EMAIL_ADDRESS' AND CM.INFO_STRING IS NOT NULL
